title: Term 3 and 4 Examination
instructions: This paper covers the work of Terms 3 and 4.
This question paper consists of 4 questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Read each question carefully before you answer it.
Show your working, and round your answers as each question asks.

sections.title: QUESTION 1: Measurement: Length, Mass, Volume, Temperature and Time

questions.prompt: Convert 385 cm to metres.
Convert 2,4 kg to grams.
Convert 25 °C to °F.
Write 8:20 p.m. in 24-hour time (e.g. 14:05).
A wall is 5 m long and 2,7 m high, with a window of 1,2 m by 1 m. One litre of paint covers 8 m², and paint is sold in 2 ℓ tins. How many tins are needed for two coats?
questions.memo:
✓ Wall area 13,5 m² − 1,2 m² = 12,3 m² (1)
✓ Two coats: 24,6 m² (1)
✓ Paint: 24,6 ÷ 8 = 3,075 ℓ (1)
✓ 2 tins (4 ℓ) (1)

questions.prompt: On a 1 : 100 000 map, the route from home to a stadium is 18 cm. If a taxi travels at an average of 60 km/h, how long will the trip take?
questions.memo:
✓ Real distance = 18 km (1)
✓ Time = 18 ÷ 60 = 0,3 h (1)
✓ = 18 minutes (1)

questions.prompt: Give TWO things that make written directions easy to follow.
questions.memo: Any two (1 each): use landmarks; give turns clearly (left/right); give distances or number of streets; use street names; give compass directions

questions.prompt: Which is continuous data?
Find the mode of: 4; 6; 6; 7; 8; 6; 9; 4
Which average is best for describing house prices in an area with a few mansions?
In a survey of 60 people, 15 prefer rugby. What angle should rugby have in a pie chart?
A company's bar graph of sales starts its vertical axis at R95 000. Explain why this could be misleading.
questions.memo:
✓ The axis does not start at zero (1)
✓ so small differences in sales look much bigger than they are (1)

questions.prompt: A learner wants to know how much time Grade 10s spend on social media. Describe how she could collect, organise and represent the data.
questions.memo:

✓ Organise: frequency table of time groups (1)
✓ Represent: histogram or bar graph; calculate averages (1)
